Figure 7: Average gated fusion weights across datasets and domains. The learned fusion weights reveal distinct interaction preferences across tasks. Video-based group activity datasets assign larger weights to temporal interactions, sensor-based HAR datasets rely on a more balanced combination of spatial and temporal reasoning, while skeleton-based two-person interaction datasets strongly emphasize temporal dependencies with comparatively smaller cross-interaction contributions. These results indicate that the proposed structured block adaptively reweights spatial, temporal, and cross spatio-temporal interactions according to the characteristics of each domain.
